method: Union of GPU timestamp intervals within each phase and frame; phases can overlap and are not additive.
profile_window_note: Metal keeps a rolling bounded sample history. On profile retains 170 complete DDGI frames from the tail; statistics use the last 160 frames for both runs (frames 321..480), after two full probe sweeps.
gpu_command_buffer_method: Duration of each completed Metal command buffer, using last 160 submissions. Includes encoded rendering/presentation work; does not include CPU encoding or predict interactive FPS. No API/shader validation; GPU counters enabled for both runs.
